interaction_history.overview: Reginald Owen portrays Charles Dickens' holiday humbug Ebenezer Scrooge, the miser's miser who has a huge change of heart after spirits whisk him into the past, present and future.
interaction_history.title: Christmas Carol, A

interaction_history.overview: A budding romance between noble underachiever Lloyd Dobler and high school valedictorian Diane Court is threatened when Diane's overly possessive, disapproving father interferes with their relationship. With a prized scholarship to study abroad hanging in the balance, Diane must find a way to make both men happy.
interaction_history.title: Say Anything...

interaction_history.overview: The story of Nola Darling's simultaneous sexual relationships with three different men is told by her and by her partners and other friends. All three men wanted her to commit solely to them; Nola resists being "owned" by a single partner.
interaction_history.title: She's Gotta Have It

interaction_history.overview: A boy preacher named Isaac goes to a town in Nebraska called Gatlin and gets all the children to murder every adult in town.
interaction_history.title: Children of the Corn

interaction_history.overview: An employee of a corporation with a lucrative secret process is tempted to betray it. But there's more to it than that.
interaction_history.title: Spanish Prisoner, The

interaction_history.overview: Princess Leia is captured and held hostage by the evil Imperial forces in their effort to take over the galactic Empire. Venturesome Luke Skywalker and dashing captain Han Solo team together with the loveable robot duo R2-D2 and C-3PO to rescue the beautiful princess and restore peace and justice in the Empire.
interaction_history.title: Star Wars: Episode IV - A New Hope

interaction_history.overview: A glowing orb terrorizes a young girl with a collection of stories of dark fantasy, eroticism and horror.
interaction_history.title: Heavy Metal

interaction_history.overview: Charismatic teen Ferris Bueller plays hooky in Chicago with his girlfriend and best friend.
interaction_history.title: Ferris Bueller's Day Off

interaction_history.overview: Naive and idealistic Jefferson Smith, leader of the Boy Rangers, is appointed on a lark by the spineless governor of his state. He is reunited with the state's senior senator--presidential hopeful and childhood hero, Senator Joseph Paine. In Washington, however, Smith discovers many of the shortcomings of the political process as his earnest goal of a national boys' camp leads to a conflict with the state political boss, Jim Taylor. Taylor first tries to corrupt Smith and then later attempts to destroy Smith through a scandal.
interaction_history.title: Mr. Smith Goes to Washington

interaction_history.overview: Amidst a nuclear war, a plane carrying a group of schoolboys crash lands on a deserted island. With no adult survivors, the boys are forced to fend for themselves. At first they cooperate, but when the they split into two separate camps -- one led by the pragmatic Ralph and the other by militaristic Jack -- their society falls into disarray, leading to a disturbing examination of human nature and a chilling conclusion.
interaction_history.title: Lord of the Flies
